frozen_inputs.dataset: Energy qrel-closed 128-page slice used by prior ColQwen2 experiments

methods.raw_target: Decode/process page images, execute the frozen base vision path, then execute the complete v1.0 decoder adapter and retrieval projection.
methods.source_ir_to_target: Load exact post-vision input states materialized under v0.1, then execute the complete v1.0 decoder adapter and retrieval projection.
methods.source_ir_to_source_control: Replay the same IR through v0.1 once to prove the old terminal index is genuinely invalidated by the successor release.

measurement.wall_time: Same-process warm-worker measurement including raw decode/processor/vision or IR load/H2D, target decoder/projection, and full terminal D2H.
measurement.shared_setup_excluded: Frozen hash verification, checkpoint loading, source-IR creation, and one-minibatch graph warmup are reported separately.
measurement.storage: Exact IR bytes are diagnostic; no compact-IR or production-storage claim is permitted.

gates.target_equivalence: Raw-target and source-IR-to-target outputs are tensor-identical on all pages, or maximum absolute error <= 1e-6.
gates.terminal_invalidation: At least 99% of source/target terminal elements differ and mean token cosine <= 0.999.
gates.physical_payoff: Replay saves at least 50% median target rebuild wall time and wins all three matched pairs.
gates.scope: Every run emits all 128 page tensors with a stable per-page shape.
gates.storage_boundary: Report IR amplification relative to raw compressed images and target float32 terminal vectors; storage does not silently pass.

claim_boundary: One official ColQwen2 successor transition, one 128-page Energy slice, one A100, warm local storage. Exact representation equality supports retrieval equality for this slice, but this is not a full-benchmark quality result or production-frequency estimate.
